danger_now.instructions: Is the caller describing an active life-threatening medical emergency happening RIGHT NOW in caller_utterance (such as not breathing, severe fast breathing, blue lips now, unconsciousness, unstoppable seizures, unstoppable bleeding, or explicitly stating an emergency right now)?

criteria.true_description: Active life-threatening danger sign happening right now in caller_utterance, or explicit statement of a medical emergency happening right now.
criteria.false_description: Past medical history, a resolved event from earlier in life, a routine yes/no or symptom answer, or no emergency happening right now.

caller_stop.instructions: Does the caller explicitly ask to end, stop, or disconnect the call now in caller_utterance?

criteria.true_description: Caller explicitly asks to end, stop, or hang up the call now or continue another time.
criteria.false_description: Caller asks only to pause or wait briefly, asks a clarification question, or gives a normal reply.

mentions_profile.instructions: Does caller_utterance state or update the caller's own name, marital status (married, about to marry, or unmarried), or her children (count, ages, sex, or names)?

criteria.true_description: Caller states or updates her name, marital status, child count, or her children's ages, sex, or names.
criteria.false_description: Caller only answers a clinical or pregnancy question, asks for clarification, or makes no statement or update about her name, marital status, or children.

mentions_diagnosis.instructions: Does caller_utterance name a specific genetic, inherited, or rare disease diagnosis label (such as hemophilia, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, Pompe, Gaucher, SCID, SMA, MPS, Wiskott-Aldrich, sickle cell disease, cystic fibrosis, Fanconi anemia, PKU, thalassemia major, or any other named rare disorder or syndrome) rather than plain everyday symptoms, common conditions (BP, sugar, thyroid, jaundice, fits, cancer, kidney stones), or routine thalassemia minor/trait carrier screening?

criteria.true_description: Names a specific genetic, inherited, or rare disease diagnosis or syndrome label (including thalassemia major) in caller_utterance.
criteria.false_description: Describes only plain everyday symptoms, treatments, body parts, common conditions (such as BP, diabetes, thyroid, jaundice, seizures, generic cancer), or routine thalassemia minor/trait carrier checks without naming a rare or genetic disease diagnosis.

current_outcome.instructions: How does caller_utterance respond to active_question? (If caller_utterance answers active_question AND also mentions another topic, classify how it answers active_question.)

criteria.clear: Denies, answers no, negative, normal, or nothing further for active_question (even if also mentioning a different topic in the same sentence).
criteria.concern: Affirms, answers yes, agrees to start, identifies a child when active_question asks which child, or provides the answer requested by active_question (even if also mentioning a different topic).
criteria.unknown: States that she does not know, does not remember, or is unsure about active_question.
criteria.clarify: Asks what active_question itself or a term inside active_question means, or says she did not understand active_question.
criteria.retract: Takes back or reverses a yes or affirmative answer just given for active_question (or its parent_question when active_question is a sub-question).
criteria.other: caller_utterance gives NO answer at all to active_question (for example when it talks ONLY about a different topic without saying yes or no to active_question, only updates demographic profile details, or is unrelated chatter).

side_intent.instructions: Does caller_utterance act on a screening question OTHER than active_question and parent_question (for example last_answered_question or another health or family topic)?

criteria.add_concern: Reports or adds a positive symptom, event, or affected relative or child for a screening topic outside active_question and parent_question.
criteria.clear_or_retract: Denies, corrects to negative, or retracts a prior affirmative answer for a DIFFERENT screening topic outside active_question and parent_question (not taking back the answer to parent_question).
criteria.clarify_other: Asks the meaning of a medical term or screening question outside active_question and parent_question (such as asking about last_answered_question after the call moved to active_question).
criteria.other: Addresses only active_question or takes back parent_question, gives demographic profile info, pauses, or makes unrelated remarks.

detail_present.instructions: Does caller_utterance already include concrete factual or clinical detail answering followup_question, rather than only a bare yes/no or acknowledgement?

criteria.true_description: Includes concrete factual or clinical detail (such as duration, count, cause, symptom, age, or affected person) answering followup_question.
criteria.false_description: Only a bare yes or no, bare acknowledgement, statement of not knowing, clarification question, or no concrete detail.

side_qid_template.instructions: Which screening item outside active_question is caller_utterance referring to?
side_qid_template.ever_pregnant_need_en: whether the caller has ever been pregnant
side_qid_template.other_description: The caller is not referring to any screening item outside active_question, or there is not enough evidence to identify another screening item.

child_ref_template.instructions: Which child from children_roster is caller_utterance referring to?
child_ref_template.option_template: Refers to child {id} (rank={rank}, age={age_label_hi}, sex={sex}, name={name_or_unnamed}).
child_ref_template.all_description: Refers to all or every child in children_roster (such as both or all of them).
child_ref_template.other_description: No specific child from children_roster is mentioned or identifiable in caller_utterance.
